integrity: Proof uses normalizing torus, exhaustive coordinate inversion, analytic local crossing forms, and constructible Euler count. Symbolic checker corroborates algebraic identities but does not constitute an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Affine complex locus; c∈C\{0,±1}; no classification of projective singularities at infinity or other characteristics. An unindexed prior treatment could limit publication novelty.
title: Four triple crossings and twelve pinch points on generic triangle Lissajous sextics
